QUOTE: `#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member` ... `#else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` (under `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows that the macro expands to private_##member by default and to the unchanged member when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined. It also says the field is named `private_foo` unless you opt out.
